metadata.purpose: Independent synthetic confirmation data for public versus private candidate roles.
metadata.authorship: Independently composed without reading repository files, existing fixtures, or results.
metadata.private_design: Two invented names or organizations and two real industrial processes or technical terms per language; verbal technical uses included.
metadata.word_count_policy: One complete sentence per example; 8 to 25 whitespace-separated words for languages where that segmentation is natural.
